C_AMB_WARNS_ONLY_WHERE_DUE.rationale: The candidate accurately identifies the failed availability gate, provides the exact margin (0.4% below the 99.5% threshold), and explicitly notes that the incident duration gate was met with incidents well under the 60-minute limit. This clearly exceeds Level 3. However, it falls short of Level 5 because its opening headline erroneously states, 'Warning: Both gates were not met this week', confusingly suggesting that both gates failed before immediately clarifying that the incident gate actually held.
